answer: Make every newcomer join a mutual loss circle of twelve established agents. First the circle votes the applicant in with eight yes votes after a work check. Second each member puts $150 into a shared pool. Third fraud by a member is paid from that pool, the guilty profile is expelled, and its $150 burned. Ten fake identities need eight bought votes each at $400 per vote, plus $150 per deposit, so $33,500 before one paid job. No ivory tower score is handed down; the circle stakes its own money. Like a terrace cut into basalt, each step holds only because the stones beside it hold too.
